criteria.description: Define object identity, representations, multi-piece layers, anchors, views and delivery requirements, with implemented capabilities distinguished from future extensions.
Run identity and engine checks and produce a validated source ZIP and checksum through a pinned GitHub workflow.
Deliver a registered-project compatibility ZIP without root recipe proposal for ZipRunner 1.2.304.125; maintain full recipe in Git and validate full-spec candidate in CI.
Add three hairstyles, bow tie and three headbands, with independent optional headwear/neckwear IDs and colours, stable old codes and guided controls.
Register four original, isolated, recolourable portrait outfits as clothing IDs 12–15 without changing old IDs or canonical rendering behavior.

checks.description: Release identity and contract reference checks
assertions: Project and version match across package, recipe, workboard, capabilities and verification plan.
Specification links resolve and delivered work maps to packaged checks.

checks.description: Saved identity restoration and metadata stability
assertions: All 4480 facial combinations roundtrip without ID changes.
Metadata ordering and labels do not change encoded values.
New headwear and neckwear selections and colours are independent; old character codes are unchanged.
New clothing IDs 12–15 can be encoded and decoded without affecting existing IDs and images.

checks.description: Archive byte integrity and ZipRunner producer validation
assertions: ZIP entries exactly match the collected source payloads and CRC checks pass.
Pinned upstream validator accepts the archive with the required functional verification plan.

checks.description: Character architecture and contributor contract review
checks.instructions: Read both AsciiDoc specifications and confirm the intended layering, representation, framing and artist requirements are clear. Confirm planned capabilities are not reported as implemented.

checks.description: GitHub validation and packaging workflow review
checks.instructions: Inspect a workflow run for this commit. Confirm identity checks and tests pass and the ZIP plus checksum are downloadable artifacts.
Import 3.0.6 into the existing CharacterBuilder project; confirm there is no recipe case-mismatch/proposal, then run build and inspect the workshop.

checks.description: Independent portrait accessories and feminine hairstyles
checks.instructions: In Hair select each new hairstyle and headwear; in Clothing select a bow tie without changing the shirt. Change each accessory colour, save/restore the code and check alignment on several heads. Headbands occupy one headwear slot.

In the workshop choose clothing IDs 12, 13, 14, and 15 on several heads. Verify neck and head remain visible, garments stay registered, clothing tint works, a save/restore code retains each choice, and no other slot changes. Perform this before approving publication.
